transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm here because lately I just can't keep my head clear at work. I'm a therapist, and... I've been losing track of what my clients are saying during sessions. I'll catch myself rereading the same chart note over and over, and then I just freeze up on simple decisions that I used to handle without even thinking about it. It's getting really hard to do my job.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with loved ones?

Yeah, I have. Um... my guitar has just been sitting in the corner for a while now. I keep bailing on soccer, and I haven't been going to help out at the shelter, either. Even when I actually try to force myself to do something I used to like, like cook a meal or go hiking... it just feels like I'm going through the motions. There's just no point to it anymore. I don't get anything out of it.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or blaming yourself for things that aren’t your fault?

Yeah, I have. It happens a lot at work lately. If I just miss one small detail in a note, or... if I forget to return a call right away, I just keep telling myself I'm useless. I feel like I'm letting my clients down, and really everyone else at the clinic, too, just because I keep messing up.
Have you found yourself worrying excessively about a number of everyday things, like work, health, or personal responsibilities, even when there isn’t a clear problem to solve?

No, not really. I mean, I definitely get down on myself when I mess up at work, like I just said, but I'm not constantly worrying about other things. I don't really sit around stressing over my health or paying bills or anything like that. If anything, it's more like... I just feel too drained to even care about most of that stuff right now.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still and feel restless lately?

Um, no, not really. I haven't noticed any changes in how I move. I don't feel like I'm moving in slow motion or anything like that. And I'm definitely not restless or having trouble sitting still. So, no, nothing like that.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even after getting enough rest?

Yeah, I have. I just have no energy lately, no matter how much rest I get. It's gotten to the point where even small stuff... like showering, driving to the clinic, or finishing up my paperwork... it just feels like I'm dragging around a backpack full of bricks. It takes so much effort just to do the basics right now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Um... I wouldn't really say I feel down or sad, no. I mean, I know I just said I'm completely drained all the time, but it's not really a sad feeling for me. I'm not walking around crying or feeling depressed all day. It's more just... feeling kind of empty and tired, I guess. So, no, I haven't really noticed feeling down like that.
Have you had days where you felt down or in a depressed mood most of the time, and if so, has this happened most days over a two-week period?

Um, like I was just saying, I don't really feel sad or down. It's not a depressed mood for me. I know it's been a couple of weeks of feeling completely drained and just... empty, but it's not sadness. So, no, I wouldn't say I've felt depressed most of the time.
Have you found that you no longer take any pleasure or interest in almost all activities, even those you used to enjoy the most?

Yeah, I have. My guitar has just been sitting in the corner for a while now. I keep bailing on playing soccer, and I haven't been going to the shelter either. Even when I try to force myself to do things I usually like... um, like cooking or going for a hike... it just feels like I'm going through the motions. There's just no point to it. I don't get any enjoyment out of any of it right now.
